parameters.query:
INSERT INTO intraday.calendar_versions (trade_date, open_at, close_at, early_close, is_open, source, version)
VALUES (
  $1::date,
  ($1 || ' ' || $2)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York',
  ($1 || ' ' || $3)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York',
  $4::boolean, true, 'alpaca_calendar', 1
)
ON CONFLICT (trade_date, source, version) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO intraday.session_manifests
  (session_id, trade_date, open_at, close_at, early_close, universe_id, discovery_cov, ranking_version,
   membership_version, feed_mode, required_sources, freshness_ms, symbols, config_hash, frozen_at)
VALUES (
  uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), 'intraday:' || $1),
  $1::date,
  ($1 || ' ' || $2)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York',
  ($1 || ' ' || $3)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York',
  $4::boolean, 'intraday_movers', $5::jsonb, $6,
  to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDD"T"HH24MISS'), 'engineering', ARRAY['alpaca_iex'], $7::jsonb,
  CASE WHEN $8 = 'freeze' THEN $9::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
  $10,
  CASE WHEN $8 = 'freeze' THEN now() ELSE NULL END
)
ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET
  open_at = EXCLUDED.open_at, close_at = EXCLUDED.close_at, early_close = EXCLUDED.early_close,
  discovery_cov = EXCLUDED.discovery_cov, ranking_version = EXCLUDED.ranking_version,
  freshness_ms = EXCLUDED.freshness_ms, config_hash = EXCLUDED.config_hash,
  symbols = CASE WHEN $8 = 'freeze' AND intraday.session_manifests.frozen_at IS NULL
                 THEN EXCLUDED.symbols ELSE intraday.session_manifests.symbols END,
  membership_version = CASE WHEN $8 = 'freeze' AND intraday.session_manifests.frozen_at IS NULL
                 THEN EXCLUDED.membership_version ELSE intraday.session_manifests.membership_version END,
  frozen_at = CASE WHEN $8 = 'freeze' AND intraday.session_manifests.frozen_at IS NULL
                 THEN now() ELSE intraday.session_manifests.frozen_at END
RETURNING session_id, frozen_at, jsonb_array_length(symbols) AS n_symbols, config_hash;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (function(){ const r = $('Rank + gate').first().json; return [r.trade_date, r.open_time, r.close_time, r.early_close, r.discovery_cov, r.ranking_version, r.freshness, r.phase, r.symbols_json, r.config_hash]; })() }}

parameters.content:
## Triggers + session gate

06:00 prep and every 5 min 08:00-09:55 ET. Get today's calendar; on a non-trading day the gate stops the run. phase = prep / scan / freeze (>= OPEN-5m).

## Discovery + rank

Union Alpaca movers (gap%) and most-actives (liquidity), enrich with one snapshots batch. Frozen v0: gate price>=$5 and dollar_vol>=$5M, rank by abs(gap%), cap 10 + SPY/QQQ benchmarks. Places no orders.

## Persist + freeze

Each scan preserves a candidate snapshot and upserts the calendar. session_id = uuid_generate_v5, matching the recorder's bars. The manifest freezes once at OPEN-5m, never overwritten.
